## `CrossAxisAlignment` { #crossaxisalignment-enum }

`public enum CrossAxisAlignment`

Controls placement of children along the cross axis (perpendicular to flow).

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `Start` | Align children to the start of the cross axis (default). |
| `Center` | Center children on the cross axis. |
| `End` | Align children to the end of the cross axis. |
| `Stretch` | Expand children to fill the entire cross axis. |

## `FlowDirection` { #flowdirection-enum }

`public enum FlowDirection`

Horizontal reading direction of a subtree. A right-to-left subtree is the mirror image of its left-to-right layout: rows run from the right edge, the left padding and margin of an entity act as its start side, and text aligned to `Start` sits on the right.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `Inherit` | Use the parent's direction; the root uses the app's direction. |
| `LeftToRight` |  |
| `RightToLeft` |  |

## `ImageScaleMode` { #imagescalemode-enum }

`public enum ImageScaleMode`

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `Cover` | Scale to cover bounds, crop excess. Default. |
| `Fit` | Scale to fit inside bounds, letterbox. |
| `Fill` | Stretch to fill bounds exactly (distorts aspect ratio). |
| `None` | Draw at natural size, centered in bounds. |

## `LayoutDirection` { #layoutdirection-enum }

`public enum LayoutDirection`

Specifies the direction in which a layout is arranged.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `Vertical` | Represents a vertical arrangement of layout elements. |
| `Horizontal` | Represents a horizontal arrangement of layout elements. |
| `ZStack` | Represents a stacking arrangement of layout elements where child elements are placed on top of each other. |
| `LazyVertical` | Vertical layout with scroll support. Children are measured to compute total content height. RenderSystem clips to viewport and applies scroll offset. Used by LazyColumn and ScrollColumn. |
| `LazyHorizontal` | Horizontal layout with scroll support. Children are measured to compute total content width. RenderSystem clips to viewport and applies scroll offset. Used by LazyRow and ScrollRow. |

## `LayoutDirtyFlags` { #layoutdirtyflags-enum }

`public enum LayoutDirtyFlags`

Bitfield flags indicating which layout passes are stale for an entity.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | No passes are stale. |
| `Measure` | Desired size is stale — measure pass required. |
| `Arrange` | Position is stale — arrange pass required. |
| `Visual` | Render-only change (color, radius) — skip layout entirely. |
| `Children` | Child list changed — triggers both measure and arrange. |
| `All` | All layout-affecting flags combined. Visual is excluded — it never triggers layout. |

## `MainAxisAlignment` { #mainaxisalignment-enum }

`public enum MainAxisAlignment`

Controls distribution of children along the main axis (flow direction). Horizontal for Row, Vertical for Column.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `Start` | Pack children at the start of the main axis (default). |
| `Center` | Center the group of children along the main axis. |
| `End` | Pack children at the end of the main axis. |
| `SpaceBetween` | First child at start, last at end, equal gaps between. |
| `SpaceAround` | Equal space around each child (half-gaps at edges). |
| `SpaceEvenly` | Equal space between children and at both edges. |

## `TextAlignment` { #textalignment-enum }

`public enum TextAlignment`

Controls horizontal text placement inside a text entity.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `Start` | Place text at the start of its content box. |
| `Center` | Center text in its content box. |
| `End` | Place text at the end of its content box. |
